prompts.fishbone-minimal-v1:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create a professional 16:9 landscape editorial diagram for a management learning website: Fishbone analysis of a data team's missed SLA. This is a finished presentation slide, minimal but powerful. White background, dark charcoal/navy typography, restrained coral red accent (#b5322e), fine crisp lines, precise generous spacing, Swiss typography and strong hierarchy. Entirely flat graphic, no people illustrations, no 3D, no texture, no gradients, no decorative fish silhouette, no shadows, no logos, no watermark.
Title top left: "FISHBONE ANALYSIS". Subtitle: "Daily data jobs miss the SLA 6 times per month".
Center: a precise horizontal fishbone spine, three slanted cause branches above and three below, ending at a clearly readable outcome box on the right reading "6 SLA misses / month". Each branch has ONE category header and ONE concrete subcause, all labels crisp and comfortably readable, never overlapping.
Top branches from left to right:
"PEOPLE" / "Unclear holiday coverage"
"METHOD" / "Jobs run sequentially"
"TOOLS" / "Cloud quota limits"
Bottom branches from left to right:
"DATA" / "Source files arrive late"
"ENVIRONMENT" / "Month-end volume triples"
"MEASUREMENT" / "Alerts arrive after the deadline"
Highlight only DATA branch and its subcause with coral accent, all other branches navy/gray. Small footer callout in a subtle pale coral rectangle: "Validate causes with logs: 4 of 6 misses followed late source files." Smaller footer: "Hypothetical data-team example".
No extra numbers, categories or invented causal claims. Maintain rigorous educational accuracy. Composition should feel designed by a senior information designer for an executive presentation, not clip art.
prompts.priority-matrix-minimal-v1:
Use case: infographic-diagram. A finished professional 16:9 landscape executive presentation slide explaining the Eisenhower Matrix using a data-team example. Minimal but powerful. White background, dark navy text, clean flat 2x2 matrix with delicate gray rules, generous whitespace and strong typographic hierarchy. Restrained amber accent #c7791a used ONLY in the important/not urgent quadrant, which is subtly tinted pale amber. No illustrations, 3D, gradients, texture, shadows, photos, clipart, logos or watermarks.
Title top left "EISENHOWER MATRIX"; subtitle "Protect time for important work".
Precisely aligned axis labels: columns from left to right "URGENT" and "NOT URGENT"; rows from top to bottom "IMPORTANT" and "NOT IMPORTANT". Exactly four cells with these exact texts and no extra tasks:
Top left: "DO TODAY" / "Fix incorrect figures in the executive report due this afternoon."
Top right highlighted amber: "SCHEDULE" / "Write the on-call guide." / "Wednesday morning · 2 hours"
Bottom left: "DELEGATE" / "Assign today's sales data export to an analyst."
Bottom right: "REMOVE" / "Cancel the recurring meeting with no agenda."
Each cell action headline bold, task text comfortably large and readable with clean deliberate line breaks. The matrix should occupy most of slide.
Footer small insight: "Important work needs a calendar slot, not just a place on the list."
Smaller note: "Hypothetical data-team example". Typography calm, precise, professionally typeset. Do not invent metrics.
prompts.raci-minimal-v1:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a finished professional executive presentation slide, landscape 16:9, teaching a RACI responsibility matrix. Minimal but powerful information design: white background, dark navy typography, precise fine gray grid, abundant whitespace. Single restrained green accent #2b7a4b for Accountable cells. All elements flat, no people illustrations, no 3D, no textures, no gradients, no shadows, no decorative icons, logos or watermark.
Title top left "RACI MATRIX". Subtitle "One accountable owner for every task".
Large clean table, SIX columns (task plus five roles), FIVE rows (header plus four tasks). Role names use deliberate two-line breaks where needed, readable sans-serif. Exact content:
Header: "TASK" | "DATA ENGINEER" | "ANALYST" | "TEAM LEAD" | "FINANCE" | "EXECUTIVE"
Row 1: "Change revenue definition" | "R" | "C" | "C" | "A" | "I"
Row 2: "Release dashboard" | "C" | "R" | "A" | "I" | "I"
Row 3: "Fix daily job failure" | "R" | "I" | "A" | "—" | "—"
Row 4: "Grant data access" | "R" | "—" | "A" | "C" | "I"
This exact alignment is critical. Each row contains exactly ONE A. Highlight all four A cells green. Make R bold navy. Make C and I regular dark gray, dash pale gray. The first task's FINANCE A is additionally outlined to focus the lesson.
Below table a clean compact legend: "R  Responsible · does the work" | "A  Accountable · final owner" | "C  Consulted · asked before action" | "I  Informed · kept updated".
Footer insight: "Revenue definitions belong to Finance: approve changes before implementation."
Smaller footer: "Hypothetical data-team example".
Make an elegant publication quality diagram with readable, accurate type. No extra rows, roles or letters.
prompts.fishbone-illustrated-v1: Create a polished editorial infographic image for the Fishbone (Ishikawa) Diagram, 16:9 landscape. A single large central fish skeleton made of clean curved navy lines flowing right toward a clearly empty effect circle. Six branching cause categories shown as colorful illustrated clusters: People (warm coral), Process (golden yellow), Technology (teal), Materials (violet), Measurement (sky blue), Environment (leaf green). Visual style: premium modern strategy consulting presentation, elegant off-white paper texture, subtle shadows, generous whitespace, tactile paper cutout accents, crisp vector-like shapes. Absolutely no words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, or readable text. The diagram structure must be intuitive without text. Use only the image, no decorative border.
prompts.priority-matrix-illustrated-v1: Create a refined, modern visual explainer for the Eisenhower Matrix, 16:9 landscape. Four equal rounded quadrants arranged in a balanced 2x2 matrix, clearly separated by wide pale gaps. Each quadrant has a distinct visual metaphor with no text: urgent and important uses a coral red flame and a focused person; important but less urgent uses an amber compass and a sprouting plant; urgent but less important uses a bright blue ringing bell and outgoing message marks; neither urgent nor important uses a soft lavender pause symbol and calm cloud. Style: premium consulting slide, elegant paper-cut layered 3D objects, white-to-warm-cream textured backdrop, navy grid frame, sophisticated soft shadows, generous whitespace, crisp accessible color contrast. Absolutely no words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, or readable text. No decorative border.
prompts.raci-illustrated-v1: Create a polished visual explainer for a RACI responsibility matrix, 16:9 landscape. Show one central project deliverable as a clean glowing amber card icon with four human role groups placed around it in a balanced system: one lead figure actively holding a tool (accountability metaphor), several diverse collaborators moving task pieces (responsibility metaphor), two expert advisers with speech bubbles (consulted metaphor), and a calm audience group receiving a flowing update line (informed metaphor). Use an elegant navy connective diagram: solid paths for active ownership, dotted paths for consultation, light flowing lines for updates. Style: premium modern management consulting slide, tactile paper-cut 3D illustration, refined warm-cream background, teal coral gold violet accents, clean composition and generous whitespace. Absolutely no words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, or readable text. No decorative border.
